x: "Where did I come Reg?" - Boys High Jump at Club Champs.

"Poor old Reg was so worried that our Youths team wouldn't arrive in good time for the National(some of them had more than a mile to travel poor things) that he very nearly booked hotel accomadation!"

With Reg chauffeuring our youngsters to their many fixtures some odd things have happened. Once, he even managed to get lost in Hyde Park and on another occasion found himself in an Atomic Power Station.

Our second win of the day was with Reg Hopkins doing his thing (Fosbury) high jump. Like Dave,Reg is now taking this field event seriously, working to a schedule with weights and excercises and trying to perfect a technique.

The referee and starter by tradition was our President; Reg is no newcomer to walking and appreciates its techniques and disciplines. The judges panel was headed by Syd Spencer, who did the job with his usual quiet efficiency.
I would like to thank Duncan, Reg, Ted, Rosemary and Claire for sharing the load, also the increasing band of parents for solving the transport logistics of ferrying indistinguishable boys and mud.
